subject: Red Rupee
text: A small chest on a low pillar in the spike trap room contains a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest for a Red Rupee, then pick up a bomb.

subject: Bomb Bag
text: A large treasure chest on the north side of the spike trap room contains the Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: Jump across, then open the large treasure chest to finally get a BOMB BAG for some BOMBS.

subject: Giant Dodongo Head
text: Dropping bombs into the gaps on the bridge so they explode inside both eyes of the giant Dodongo head opens its mouth.

evidence.quote: Head to the bridge, and drop bombs right at the gaps. If you do it well, the bombs will blow up inside the giant Dodongo head's eyes. Do it on both eyes to open the mouth of the large head.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: A small chest behind a weak wall across the bridge contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Across the bridge is a weak wall with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee behind it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula guarded by an Armos is located behind a bombable weak wall in the corridor beyond the Dodongo head.

evidence.quote: Kill the Armos guarding the Gold Skulltula before getting the Skulltula in this room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 021 out of 100)

subject: Bombs
text: A small chest in the room leading to the boss hole contains Bombs.

evidence.quote: Go through, open the small chest for some Bombs if you need them, and blast open the middle of the floor to reveal a hole.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Throwing a bomb down King Dodongo's gullet while he inhales will stun him, leaving his head vulnerable to sword slashes.

evidence.quote: Basically avoid this boss until he starts to inhale. When he does, whip out a Bomb and throw it straight down his gullet. This'll stun him, so run up and slash his head with your sword.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo's rolling attack can be avoided by standing on the very edge of the platform next to the lava.

evidence.quote: He can be easily avoided here by standing on the very edge of the platform where it meets the lava.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo can be defeated faster by performing jump strikes with Deku Sticks and repeated shield stabs once he is stunned.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: Just jump strike with Deku Sticks and shield stab (hold R and press B repeatedly while not locked on) after he's stunned to defeat him more quickly.

subject: Heart Container
text: Defeating King Dodongo cools the lava and spawns a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: After defeating him, the lava will cool, a light will appear, and a Heart Container will appear. Grab the Heart Container, (6 hearts now!) and exit using the light.

subject: Goron's Ruby
text: Exiting Dodongo's Cavern causes Darunia to reward Link with the Goron's Ruby and make him a Sworn Brother of the Gorons.

evidence.quote: You'll appear outside Dodongo's Cavern, where Darunia will greet you, give you the Goron's Ruby, and make you a Sworn Brother of the Gorons.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing a discolored section of wall on the left side of the path to Kakariko Village at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head down the path that leads to Kakariko Village, and watch for a discolored section of wall on the left side. When you see it, (make sure it's night, remember you can use the Sun's Song to change from day to night and vice versa) bomb it and you'll see a Gold Skulltula there. Kill it, then climb the normal wall to grab the token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 022 out of 100)

subject: Purple Rupee
text: A small chest behind a bombable discolored section of wall along the path contains a Purple Rupee worth 50 normal rupees.

evidence.quote: (While getting there, there's another discolored section of wall you can bomb. A small chest containing a Purple Rupee worth 50 normal ones is behind it.)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden inside a crate at the end of the boulder maze on the top level of Goron City.

evidence.quote: At the top level, you can head to a room full of rocks. Use bombs on the brown rocks to break them and try to get through this maze. At the end you should find a Gold Skulltula inside a crate, plus two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 023 out of 100)

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Two small chests at the end of the boulder maze on the top level of Goron City each contain a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: At the end you should find a Gold Skulltula inside a crate, plus two small chests with a Purple Rupee in each.

subject: Big Bomb Bag
text: Stopping the rolling Goron on the third floor with a bomb rewards Link with the Big Bomb Bag, which holds 30 Bombs.

evidence.quote: Talk to him and he'll give you a BIG BOMB BAG for your effort. This holds 30 Bombs, and trust me, Bombs are important in this game, and you need a lot of them.

subject: Cow
text: A Secret Cave revealed by blowing up boulders on the way to the summit contains a cow that can fill an Empty Bottle with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: The last one reveals a Secret Cave. Drop inside to get some Rupees, Recovery Hearts, and a cow. (What is that doing there?) You can use the cow to fill an Empty Bottle with Lon Lon Milk if you wish.

subject: Great Fairy of Power
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the summit's Great Fairy Fountain summons the Great Fairy of Power, granting a magic meter and the Spin Attack.

evidence.quote: Stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby to summon the Great Fairy of Power. She'll teach you a new move that requires magic power. You now have a magic meter. The technique is a powered spinning slash. Hold B until your sword glows yellow, then release to spin around and unleash a magic wave over a long distance.

subject: Bombs
text: Destroying the boulder surrounded by a circle of rocks inside the Crater reveals a Secret Cave containing a small chest with Bombs.

evidence.quote: Anyway, once you enter, find the boulder surrounded by a circle of rocks. Destroy the boulder to reveal a Secret Cave. Drop inside for a small chest with Bombs inside.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Climbing down the wall along the north edge inside Death Mountain Crater leads to an alcove with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now, head to the north edge, and walk slowly off it. Link should grab the wall, and it turns out to be a climbable wall. There's another Piece of Heart in an alcove here. Collect it to complete another heart! (HEART PIECES: 08 out of 36)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Destroying a crate near the entrance inside Death Mountain Crater reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Before you exit, destroy the crate near the exit to reveal a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 024 out of 100)

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Landing on the chicken pen from the roof where the owl drops Link off allows access to a cage containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Fall off the east side of the house and make it so that you land on top of the chicken pen. Enter the door here and you'll be inside a cage with a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 09 out of 36)

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Talking to the person in the lower left of the Skulltula House rewards Link with the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote: Talk to the other guy (lower left person) and he'll reward you with the STONE OF AGONY, an item that activates the Rumble Pak whenever you are near secrets.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Defeating the two Redeads in the Secret Cave between the village tree and the well stairs spawns a chest with a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Inside are two Redeads. Kill them easily by playing the Sun's Song first, and after they're gone, a chest will appear containing a Huge Rupee, worth a whopping 200 Rupees.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Bombing the wall inside the chamber where the Hylian Shield was found opens a path to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Head to the Graveyard and go back into the chamber that contained the Hylian Shield. Bomb the wall, and follow the hall to reveal a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Blasting the boulder near the Goron City warp entrance in the Lost Woods reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Blast the boulder here to reveal a Secret Cave. Inside is a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
text: A Business Scrub in a Secret Cave under a boulder in the Lost Woods sells a Deku Nut Upgrade allowing Link to carry 30 Deku Nuts for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Blast it and head down this cave to see a Business Deku Scrub that'll sell you a DEKU NUT UPGRADE for 40 Rupees. Take it if you have the money. (I'm sure you do; we haven't been spending money lately.) The other Business Scrub just sells you Deku Seeds at a very expensive price. This upgrade lets you carry 30 Deku Nuts.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Blasting a boulder near three trees to the left of the drawbridge reveals a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Head to the drawbridge, then head left from it. You'll see three trees and a boulder. Blast the boulder and head down the Secret Cave. There's a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Crossing the river to the left in Hyrule Field and blowing up the boulder reveals a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Keep heading left in the Field until you get to a river with some trees. Cross the river and blow up the boulder (careful of the Peahat) and drop in to find another Fairy Fountain.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Business Scrub in a Secret Cave inside the fenced box formation in southern Hyrule Field sells a Piece of Heart for 10 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Inside is a Business Scrub who'll sell you a Piece of Heart for a very cheap 10 Rupees. You'd be a fool to turn down this deal! (HEART PIECES: 10 out of 36)

subject: Blue Rupee
text: A Secret Cave near the fenced area contains a small chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: There's another Secret Cave right by here with a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

subject: Red Rupee
text: Blasting a boulder near a mini-forest in Hyrule Field opens a Secret Cave with a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Finally, you should be near a mini-forest. Find the boulder here and blast it open for a Secret Cave. (Lots of them in Hyrule Field, as you can see.) Inside is a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Playing a game at the Bombchu Bowling Alley costs 30 Rupees and gives 10 Bombchus to aim at the target holes.

evidence.quote: It takes 30 Rupees to play a game, and you have 10 Bombchus to play with. Basically Bombchus are mobile bombs that scurry along the ground until they blow up. You have to place a Bombchu appropriately so that they run over the hole in the wall (they blow up on contact with the hole).
